question: The Union Cabinet has approved to extend the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) for how many years in September 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Three years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union Cabinet has approved to extend the **Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) **for **three years** in **September 2023**.
 
• This extension aims to provide continued support for the **distribution of free LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line** (BPL) households.
 
• PMUY was initially **launched in May 2016** with the goal of safeguarding the health of women and children by providing them with clean cooking fuel.
 
• As of the latest extension, the scheme has successfully distributed over **8 crore LPG connections**.
 
• The program has significantly contributed to the reduction of health hazards associated with the use of traditional cooking fuels such as firewood, coal, and cow-dung cakes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)** was launched by the **Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas**.
 
• The scheme is part of the government's efforts to improve energy access and promote the use of clean energy sources in rural India.
 
• Beneficiaries of the scheme are identified through the **Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) data**.
 
• Under PMUY, the government provides **financial assistance of Rs. 1,600 for each LPG connection to the eligible households**.
 
• The scheme has had a positive impact on the health and well-being of millions of women and children across India.
